title: Passcode-protected share links
objective: Let the people in a library protect a share link with a passcode. PUT /api/documents/:id/links/:linkId/passcode with { passcode } sets it (4 to 32 characters, else 400 { error: 'invalid_passcode' }); DELETE on the same path removes it. Only library members may set or remove one (404 not_found otherwise, like a missing document). The passcode is stored only as a salted hash (never in plain text, never returned); GET /api/documents/:id/links shows hasPasscode: true|false per link. A visitor opening a protected link (GET /l/:linkId) without the passcode gets 401 { error: 'passcode_required' } and nothing about the document; a wrong one (query.passcode) gets 401 { error: 'passcode_invalid' }; the right one opens it. The open is counted only after unlock. The download (GET /l/:linkId/download) follows the same rule. The visitor page (linkPage(store, linkId, { viewer, passcode })) shows a passcode form (data-testid="passcode-form") and not the title until unlocked.
acceptance: Members set and remove a passcode; 4 to 32 characters is enforced on the server
The passcode is stored only as a hash and never returned; links show hasPasscode
A visitor without the passcode, or with a wrong one, gets 401 and nothing about the document
The right passcode opens the link, and only then is the open counted
The download follows the same rule
The visitor page asks for the passcode before showing the title
plan_summary: A passcode hash (node:crypto scrypt with a salt) on the link; set/remove routes; a gate in the visitor routes and linkPage.
